question: Great sorrow or distress
solution: The loss of his job added to his woes. बहुत गहरा दुख, शोक या कष्ट।

question: To take someone somewhere suddenly and quickly
solution: The celebrity was whisked away by the security guards. किसी को बहुत तेज़ी या फुरती से कहीं ले जाना।

question: A man whose wife is dead
solution: He became a widower last year. वह पुरुष जिसकी पत्नी की मृत्यु हो गई हो (विधुर)।

question: A legal document authorizing the police to make an arrest or search premises
solution: The police obtained a warrant to search the suspect's house. पुलिस को गिरफ्तारी या तलाशी का अधिकार देने वाला कानूनी आदेश।

question: To walk or move in a leisurely or aimless way
solution: They spent the afternoon wandering through the park. बिना किसी उद्देश्य के इधर-उधर घूमना या भटकना।

question: To reduce something in size by carving or cutting
solution: He spent hours whittling a piece of wood into a small bird. किसी चीज़ को काटकर या छीलकर छोटा करना या नया आकार देना।

question: Done deliberately, knowing that it is wrong
solution: He wilfully damaged the property despite the warning. किसी गलत काम को जानबूझकर करना।

question: To separate husk from the grain
solution: Winnowing is a traditional farming method to clean grain. अनाज को भूसे से अलग करने के लिए फटकना।

question: To move along with quick, short twisting movements
solution: The worm began to wriggle on the ground. शरीर को तेज़ी से मरोड़ना या छटपटाना।

question: A homeless and helpless child
solution: A waif is a child who has no home or friends. वह बच्चा जो बेघर और असहाय हो (लावारिस)।

question: The remains of something that has been badly damaged
solution: Rescuers searched the wreckage of the plane for survivors. किसी दुर्घटना के बाद बचा हुआ मलबा या अवशेष।

question: To become limp or drooping (of plants)
solution: The flowers will wilt if they don't get enough water. पौधों का पानी की कमी से मुरझाना।

question: A decorative ring of flowers and leaves
solution: They laid a wreath at the base of the memorial. फूलों और पत्तियों को मोड़कर बनाया गया सजावटी गोल हार।

question: A raised passageway in a building
solution: The hotel has a covered walkway connecting the two buildings. किसी इमारत में बना हुआ ऊंचा पैदल रास्ता।

question: To dispute angrily
solution: The two neighbors often wrangle over the fence line. किसी बात पर गुस्से में झगड़ा या विवाद करना।

question: An unexpected piece of good fortune
solution: The inheritance was a huge windfall for the family. अचानक और अप्रत्याशित रूप से मिला कोई बड़ा लाभ।

question: A jocular person who is full of amusing anecdotes
solution: A wag is someone who likes making jokes and telling funny stories. वह व्यक्ति जो बहुत ही मज़ाकिया (humorous) हो और चुटकुले सुनाने का शौकीन हो।

question: A place where clothes are kept
solution: He hung his new suit in the wardrobe. वह अलमारी या स्थान जहाँ कपड़े रखे जाते हैं।

question: To speak in a very low tone
solution: They were talking in a whisper so as not to wake the baby. बहुत धीमी आवाज़ में फुसफुसा कर बोलना।

question: Feeling or showing extreme tiredness
solution: After the long journey, they were all very weary. बहुत अधिक शारीरिक या मानसिक थकान महसूस करना।

question: A person responsible for the supervision of a particular place or activity
solution: The prison warden is responsible for the safety of the inmates. किसी स्थान या गतिविधि की देखरेख करने वाला अधिकारी।

question: The practice of magic
solution: In the story, the old woman was accused of witchery. जादू-टोना या तंत्र-विद्या का अभ्यास।

question: A woman whose husband is dead
solution: After her husband died, she lived as a widow. वह महिला जिसके पति की मृत्यु हो गई हो।

question: A list of passengers and luggage
solution: A waybill contains details of the passengers and goods on a journey. यात्रियों और उनके सामान की सूची।

question: Amusing and strange
solution: He is famous for his wacky sense of humor and strange costumes. वह चीज़ या व्यक्ति जो बहुत ही मज़ेदार, निराला और थोड़ा अजीब (strange) हो।

question: A place with circular currents of water, which can pull objects down into it
solution: The small boat was caught in a dangerous whirlpool. पानी की वह तेज़ी से घूमने वाली गोल धारा जो चीज़ों को नीचे खींच लेती है (भँवर)।
